dogecoin.text:
Cryptocurrencies born from internet jokes/memes (no utility, pure hype).

Examples are;
DOGE (Started as a Bitcoin parody)
SHIB (The Dogecoin killer)
PEPE (Based on the frog meme)

Why Do They Explode in Value?

Community Power, Low-Price Illusion, FOMO (Fear of missing out)

The Internet’s Wildest Financial Experiment... Memecoins

From Dogecoin to Shiba Inu to BONK,

memecoins have turned jokes into billion-dollar assets.

But are they harmless fun or dangerous speculation

What Even Is a Memecoin?
